name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 acrylic layers for a premium, elegant, and modern display look.
    - Style 1:
                    +) Layer 1: Mirror acrylic with engraving for a refined reflective effect.
                    +) Layer 2: Transparent acrylic with 1-sided printing to add vivid design details and decorative framing.
    - Style 2:
                    +) Layer 1: Transparent acrylic with 2-sided printing.
                    +) Layer 2: Mirror acrylic with cutting
    - Each acrylic panel has a thickness of 3mm, creating a sturdy and durable finished sign.
    - Available mirror acrylic options:
                    +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
                    +) Silver Mirror Acrylic

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
                     +) 6 x 8 in ~ 15.24 x 20.32 cm
                     +) 8 x 12 in ~ 20.32 x 30.48 cm
                     +) 12 x 18 in ~ 30.48 x 45.72 cm
                     +) 18 x 24 in ~ 45.72 x 60.96 cm
                     +) 24 x 36 in ~ 60.96 x 91.44 cm
                     +) 30 x 30 in ~ 76.2 x 76.2 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing & Engraving Technology:
    - Combines engraving on mirror acrylic with UV printing on transparent acrylic for a layered and eye-catching effect.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a stylish decorative sign and personalized display piece.
    - Designed to enhance weddings, engagement parties, anniversaries, bridal showers, and special events with an elegant mirror effect.
    - Suitable for displaying on welcome tables, entrance areas, reception spaces, photo booths, or decorative corners.
    - The 2-layer acrylic construction creates a dimensional and eye-catching presentation that stands out beautifully in any setting.
    - Perfect for both event decoration and long-term keepsake display after the celebration.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, newlyweds, fiancés, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, bridal showers, and vow renewal celebrations.
    - Ideal for event decorators, wedding planners, and anyone who loves elegant personalized décor.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for preserving meaningful names, dates, and special memories.
    - Great for home decoration, celebration displays, and memorable milestone gifts.
    - Adds a luxurious, romantic, and personalized touch to any special occasion🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
